shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学平台旁，手里拿着一面小镜子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an optical table holding a small round mirror and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲光的波动本领。
overlay: 光的波动：反射、折射、干涉与偏振

shots.scene: 镜子、拐弯的光线、明暗条纹、栅栏四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a mirror bouncing a ray, a ray bending into water, a striped bright and dark pattern, and a picket fence. No people.
shots.narration: 反射、折射、干涉衍射，还有偏振。

shots.scene: 阿杰在光学平台上摆好一面小镜子，看着墙上的光点
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a small mirror on an optical table and bends down close to look at a light spot.
shots.narration: 阿杰摆好镜子，盯着墙上的光点。

shots.scene: 阿杰把镜子转一转，墙上光点跟着跑，他一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the small mirror slightly, and the light spot on the wall jumps to a new place; he looks puzzled.
shots.narration: 镜子一转，光点就跑，这是为什么？

shots.scene: 小研走过来，在空白白板上画出一列波
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and draws a simple wave on a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 小研说：答案藏在光的波动里。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这一课，看光像波时的种种本领。

shots.section_title: 这一课讲光“像波”的本领
shots.scene: 欣欣指着八本空白书脊，第二本发光
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of eight blank book spines; the second one glows softly.
shots.narration: 上一课说光有两副面孔。
overlay: 这一课讲光“像波”的本领

shots.section_title: 这一课讲光“像波”的本领
shots.scene: 五个图标依次亮起：镜子、拐弯光线、条纹、光点散开、栅栏
shots.prompt_en: Five icons light up one by one: a mirror, a bending ray, a striped pattern, spreading light spots, and a picket fence. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课只看它像波的那一面。

shots.scene: 一个摩天轮慢慢转动，一个车厢从底部升起
shots.prompt_en: A Ferris wheel turns slowly while one cabin rises from the middle height. No people.
shots.narration: 波的起伏，就像摩天轮转圈。

shots.scene: 摩天轮转满一圈，旁边的波浪曲线正好画完一个起伏
shots.prompt_en: As the Ferris wheel completes one full turn, a wave line beside it finishes exactly one rise and fall. No people.
shots.narration: 转一整圈三百六十度，正好一个周期。

shots.scene: 车厢停在某个位置，一个角度小扇形亮起
shots.prompt_en: The cabin stops at one spot and a small angle wedge lights up from its starting point. No people.
shots.narration: 转到哪个角度，就是此刻的相位。

shots.scene: 两个摩天轮并排，转速一样，但一个车厢在高处、一个在侧面
shots.prompt_en: Two identical Ferris wheels turn at the same speed, but one cabin is at the top while the other is at the side. No people.
shots.narration: 两列波一样长，可步子没对齐。

shots.scene: 两条波浪曲线上下排列，波峰错开四分之一
shots.prompt_en: Two wave lines stacked one above the other, their crests shifted a quarter step apart. No people.
shots.narration: 错开的这一段，叫相位差。

shots.scene: 两条波浪叠在一起，合成的新波起伏不同
shots.prompt_en: The two shifted waves overlap and form a new combined wave with a different height. No people.
shots.narration: 相位差决定两列波叠加的结果。

shots.scene: 一队士兵图标迈着整齐的步子过桥
shots.prompt_en: A row of identical marching toy soldier icons crosses a bridge in perfect step. No people.
shots.narration: 步子整齐、波长相同，叫相干光。

shots.scene: 六条一样的波浪叠成一条又高又深的大浪
shots.prompt_en: Six identical aligned wave lines stack into one very tall wave with deep troughs. No people.
shots.narration: 同步叠加，起伏一下子变得极大。

shots.scene: 激光器射出一条又细又直的光束
shots.prompt_en: A laser on an optical table emits a thin, perfectly straight beam into a beam stop. No people.
shots.narration: 激光，就是这样的相干光。

shots.scene: 一群小球各自乱跳，有高有低
shots.prompt_en: A crowd of small bouncing balls jumps at random heights and times. No people.
shots.narration: 波长不同、步调各异，叫非相干光。

shots.scene: 几条长短不一的波叠加，合成波起伏平缓
shots.prompt_en: Several waves of different lengths overlap and add up to a gentle, uneven wave. No people.
shots.narration: 叠起来有加有减，起伏比较平缓。

shots.scene: 白炽灯、弧光灯、太阳三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an incandescent bulb, an arc lamp, and the sun. No people.
shots.narration: 灯泡、弧光灯、太阳光都是非相干光。

shots.scene: 左边整齐的士兵队列，右边乱跳的小球，中间一条分隔线
shots.prompt_en: Split screen: on the left, marching soldier icons in step; on the right, randomly bouncing balls. No people.
shots.narration: 相干光步调一致，非相干光各走各的。

shots.scene: 左边一根很高的功率柱，右边一根矮柱
shots.prompt_en: Two bars side by side: a very tall glowing bar above the marching soldiers and a short bar above the jumping balls. No people.
shots.narration: 相干光的功率，远远高过非相干光。

shots.section_title: 反射：光碰到界面会弹回
shots.scene: 一个乒乓球打到桌面弹起
shots.prompt_en: A ping-pong ball hits a table surface and bounces back up. No people.
shots.narration: 光碰到两种物质的分界面，会弹回来。
overlay: 反射：光碰到界面会弹回

shots.section_title: 反射：光碰到界面会弹回
shots.scene: 镜面上的反射点竖起一条虚线
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line rises straight up from the point where a ray hits a flat mirror. No people.
shots.narration: 在碰撞点立一条垂直线，叫法线。

shots.section_title: 反射定律：反射角等于入射角
shots.scene: 入射光线和反射光线在法线两侧，两个夹角一样大
shots.prompt_en: An incoming ray and a reflected ray sit on either side of the dashed normal line, making two equal angle wedges. No people.
shots.narration: 进来的角度，等于弹出去的角度。
overlay: 反射定律：反射角等于入射角

shots.section_title: 反射定律：反射角等于入射角
shots.scene: 台球杆击球，球撞边框按对称角度弹开
shots.prompt_en: A billiard ball hits the cushion and rebounds at a mirror-image angle. No people.
shots.narration: 就像台球撞边，角度对称弹开。

shots.section_title: 反射定律：反射角等于入射角
shots.scene: 镜子倾斜一点，反射光线大幅转向
shots.prompt_en: A mirror tilts slightly and the reflected ray swings to a very different direction. No people.
shots.narration: 镜子稍一转，反射方向就跟着变。

shots.scene: 入射光、反射光、法线三根线贴在同一块透明薄板上
shots.prompt_en: The incoming ray, the reflected ray, and the normal line all lie on one thin transparent sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 入射光、反射光和法线，在同一平面。

shots.scene: 小推车从水泥地斜着推进草地，一侧先减速，车头转向
shots.prompt_en: A small cart rolls at an angle from pavement onto grass; one wheel slows first and the cart turns. No people.
shots.narration: 光换一种介质，方向就会拐弯。

shots.scene: 一根筷子插进水杯，看起来像折断了
shots.prompt_en: A chopstick placed in a glass of water looks bent at the water surface. No people.
shots.narration: 水里的筷子像折断了，就是折射。

shots.scene: 光线射到水面：一部分弹回，一部分拐进水里
shots.prompt_en: A ray hits a water surface: part of it bounces back up and part bends into the water. No people.
shots.narration: 在界面上，一部分反射，一部分折射。

shots.section_title: 折射定律：算出拐弯方向
shots.scene: 界面上的法线虚线，入射光和折射光各有一个夹角
shots.prompt_en: A dashed normal line at an interface, with one angle wedge for the incoming ray and one for the bent ray. No people.
shots.narration: 角度都从法线量起。
overlay: 折射定律：算出拐弯方向

shots.section_title: 折射定律：算出拐弯方向
shots.scene: 一架天平，两边分别放两种材料和两个角度
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a material block and an angle wedge on each pan, perfectly level. No people.
shots.narration: 两侧的材料和角度，有固定的对应关系。

shots.section_title: 折射定律：算出拐弯方向
shots.scene: 小研在空白计算器上输入，屏幕亮出一条光线方向
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student taps on a blank calculator, and a ray direction arrow appears above it.
shots.narration: 知道两种材料和入射方向，就能算出去向。

shots.scene: 光从空气进入水和进入钻石，弯折程度不同
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: a ray entering water bends a little; a ray entering a diamond bends much more. No people.
shots.narration: 两边光学密度差得越多，拐得越厉害。

shots.scene: 一排材料图标：空气、水、玻璃、钻石、硅片
shots.prompt_en: A row of material icons: air, water drop, glass block, diamond, and a silicon wafer. No people.
shots.narration: 不同材料，折射率各不相同。

shots.scene: 空气最低，钻石、硅更高，柱状高低排列
shots.prompt_en: Simple bars of rising height above each material icon, with air the lowest and silicon among the highest. No people.

shots.scene: 另一排柱子更高：火石玻璃、锆石、钻石、砷化镓、硅、锗
shots.prompt_en: A second row of taller bars for more materials: flint glass, a zircon gem, a diamond, and three semiconductor wafers. No people.

shots.scene: 光速箭头穿过各材料，越高的柱子里箭头越短
shots.prompt_en: A speed arrow passes through each material; the taller the bar, the shorter the arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 折射率越大，光在里面走得越慢。

shots.scene: 池塘里两颗石子激起的水波相遇
shots.prompt_en: Two pebbles drop into a pond and their ripples meet and overlap. No people.
shots.narration: 两列步调一致的波相遇，会叠加。

shots.scene: 波峰碰波峰变高，波峰碰波谷抵消
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: where crest meets crest the water rises higher; where crest meets trough it goes flat. No people.
shots.narration: 峰碰峰更亮，峰碰谷抵消变暗。

shots.scene: 一块挡板上开两条窄缝，光从后面照来
shots.prompt_en: A board with two narrow slits, lit evenly from behind. No people.
shots.narration: 两条窄缝，就像两个同步的光源。

shots.scene: 两组弧形波前从缝中扩散，交点处亮起
shots.prompt_en: Two sets of curved wavefronts spread from the slits; bright dots appear where they cross. No people.
shots.narration: 峰峰相遇处加强，峰谷相遇处抵消。

shots.scene: 后方屏上出现明暗相间的条纹
shots.prompt_en: On a screen behind, stripes of bright and dark alternate. No people.
shots.narration: 屏上就出现明暗相间的条纹。

shots.scene: 暗纹中心最黑，向两边慢慢变亮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of one dark stripe, darkest in the middle and gradually fading into the bright stripes. No people.
shots.narration: 暗纹中间最暗，再慢慢过渡到亮纹。

shots.scene: 光照过针孔，屏上出现一圈圈亮环
shots.prompt_en: Light passes through a pinhole and forms rings of bright circles on a screen. No people.
shots.narration: 光穿过很小的孔，会散成一圈圈亮环。

shots.scene: 单缝和锋利边缘后的条纹图
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: stripes behind a single narrow slit, and fine fringes behind a sharp straight edge. No people.
shots.narration: 窄缝、锋利边缘后面也有条纹。

shots.scene: 影子边缘处，光悄悄绕进阴影里
shots.prompt_en: At the edge of a shadow, faint light fringes creep into the shadow area. No people.
shots.narration: 孔和波长差不多大时，光会绕进影子里。

shots.scene: 缝口一个小点，向外发出一条起伏的波线
shots.prompt_en: A tiny dot at a slit sends out a single wavy line to the right. No people.
shots.narration: 把缝口想成一个小小的光源。

shots.scene: 波线上的波峰、波谷、零点换成深色点、浅色点、空心点
shots.prompt_en: The wavy line is replaced by dots: dark dots at crests, light dots at troughs, hollow dots at zero points. No people.
shots.narration: 波峰、波谷用不同的点标出来。

shots.scene: 把各方向的同类点连起来，成一圈圈弧线
shots.prompt_en: Matching dots in all directions connect into rings of curved arcs spreading from the slit. No people.
shots.narration: 同类点连成弧线，就是波前。

shots.scene: 两个缝的弧线交叉，交点处亮起，投到屏上成亮点
shots.prompt_en: Arcs from two slits cross; bright dots glow at the crossings and project onto a screen as bright spots. No people.
shots.narration: 两组波前的交点，在屏上成亮点。

shots.section_title: 颜色不同，亮点间距不同
shots.scene: 蓝色亮点排得密，红色亮点排得疏
shots.prompt_en: Two screens side by side: blue spots placed close together, red spots spaced farther apart. No people.
shots.narration: 蓝光约四百纳米，亮点挨得近。
overlay: 颜色不同，亮点间距不同

shots.section_title: 颜色不同，亮点间距不同
shots.scene: 红光波浪更长，亮点更分散
shots.prompt_en: A long red wave next to a short blue wave, with arrows pointing to the wider red spacing. No people.
shots.narration: 红光约七百纳米，亮点隔得远。

shots.section_title: 颜色不同，亮点间距不同
shots.scene: 一束白光穿过多缝的薄片，屏上出现彩虹色亮点
shots.prompt_en: A white beam passes through a thin plate with many fine slits and makes rainbow-colored spots on a screen. No people.
shots.narration: 白光过光栅，按颜色分开排列。

shots.section_title: 颜色不同，亮点间距不同
shots.scene: 阿杰在实验桌前拿起一片光栅，小研在旁看着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a thin grating slide at a lab bench while the female graduate student watches.
shots.narration: 实操课上，会用衍射光栅亲手观察。

shots.scene: 光栅、屏、亮点三者之间画着两条距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: A grating, a screen, and a row of spots, with arrows marking the distance between grating and screen. No people.
shots.narration: 亮点离中心多远，可以估算。

shots.scene: 屏推远，亮点散开；波长变长，亮点也散开
shots.prompt_en: When the screen moves back, the spots spread out; when the wave gets longer, the spots also spread out. No people.
shots.narration: 波长越长、屏越远，亮点越分散。

shots.scene: 两缝靠近，亮点反而散开
shots.prompt_en: When the two slits move closer together, the spots on the screen spread farther apart. No people.
shots.narration: 两缝挨得越近，亮点反而越分散。

shots.scene: 亮点从中心往两边编号一、二、三
shots.prompt_en: Spots on the screen are marked with first, second, and third order dots outward from the center. No people.
shots.narration: 从中心往外，依次是第一、第二个亮点。

shots.section_title: 偏振：电场朝哪个方向振
shots.scene: 一根跳绳上下抖动，旁边一根左右抖动
shots.prompt_en: One jump rope shakes up and down; another shakes side to side. No people.
shots.narration: 偏振，看的是电场朝哪个方向振。
overlay: 偏振：电场朝哪个方向振

shots.section_title: 偏振：电场朝哪个方向振
shots.scene: 一个米字形箭头，各方向都有
shots.prompt_en: A star of arrows pointing in every direction. No people.
shots.narration: 各方向乱振，叫非偏振光。

shots.section_title: 偏振：电场朝哪个方向振
shots.scene: 跳绳甩成螺旋：圆形和椭圆形
shots.prompt_en: A rope is swung so the wave traces a circular spiral, then an oval spiral. No people.
shots.narration: 还有圆偏振、椭圆偏振，分左旋右旋。

shots.scene: 跳绳穿过一道竖缝栅栏，上下抖动能过，左右抖动被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A rope passes through a fence with vertical gaps: up-and-down shaking passes through, side-to-side shaking is blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 偏振片像一道竖缝栅栏。

shots.scene: 透明塑料薄片里排着细针状晶体
shots.prompt_en: A clear plastic sheet with rows of tiny needle-shaped crystals inside. No people.
shots.narration: 片里的细针晶体，吸收一个方向。

shots.scene: 米字形箭头穿过薄片，只剩竖直箭头
shots.prompt_en: A star of arrows passes through the sheet and only vertical arrows come out. No people.
shots.narration: 非偏振光过去，变成线偏振光。

shots.scene: 老周戴着偏光太阳镜站在水边，水面反光变暗
shots.prompt_en: The older man wears polarized sunglasses by a lake; the glare on the water looks dimmer.
shots.narration: 偏光太阳镜只放一个方向的光。

shots.scene: 进入眼睛的光线箭头变少，周围景物变暗
shots.prompt_en: Fewer light arrows reach an eye icon through polarized lenses, and the scene looks darker. No people.
shots.narration: 进眼的光少了，看出去就暗一些。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现士兵队列和乱跳小球
shots.prompt_en: Beside the panda mascot float icons of marching soldiers and bouncing balls.
shots.narration: 相干光整齐，非相干光杂乱。

shots.scene: 镜子反射和筷子折射两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a mirror reflecting a ray and a chopstick bending in water. No people.
shots.narration: 反射角等于入射角，换介质会拐弯。

shots.scene: 双缝条纹和彩虹亮点
shots.prompt_en: Icons of double-slit stripes and rainbow-colored spots. No people.
shots.narration: 干涉衍射出明暗，颜色不同间距不同。

shots.scene: 竖缝栅栏和偏光太阳镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fence with vertical gaps and polarized sunglasses. No people.
shots.narration: 偏振片只放一个方向的光。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着小镜子挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small mirror and waves goodbye beside the optical table.
shots.narration: 第二课到这里，下一课讲光的粒子性。
